title: Bouncy as a Sulfur Cube
description: This datapack makes you bounce like a sulfur cube but a... tiny bit amplified, we'll say.
body:
## What is it?


 This datapack/mod makes you bounce around the world like a sulfur cube, but like, 100x farther & faster.

##  Didn't people already do this with commands?

Yes, but I made a datapack and mod to make it easier. **But I didn't make the idea of doing this.**

## What commands does it do?


```
attribute @s minecraft:bounciness base set 99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999
attribute @s minecraft:air_drag_modifier base set 0
attribute @s minecraft:water_movement_efficiency base set 999999999999
attribute @s minecraft:friction_modifier base set 0
attribute @s minecraft:fall_damage_multiplier base set 0
```
Run /trigger startbounce to do this and /trigger stopbounce to use "base reset" on all of these attributes.
